title.value: Automate blog writing, translation, publishing and video digests

introduction.value: The author's Hermes Agent drafts and translates blog posts, publishes to Cloudflare Pages, makes Shorts and a weekly digest video for YouTube, and asks for approval on Telegram.

method.value: Hermes Agent runs natively under systemd on an always-on Ubuntu mini-PC. For blogging, it drafts posts, translates them to German and Persian, works in a Git worktree, adds SEO metadata and opens a PR. For video, it watches the blog's RSS feed hourly, renders Shorts and a weekly digest with ffmpeg, Pillow and Google TTS, uploads them as private, and sends a Telegram Approve button.

outcome.value: The author says blogging drops from hours to minutes. The source gives no measured results. Scheduled publishing, thumbnails and reader-feedback analysis are still planned, and the author's later posts say he replaced Hermes with his own harness.

notes.value: The agent runs unsandboxed with passwordless sudo. The only protection is a Telegram allowlist and a dashboard password, so treat those as your security boundary.

source_text.body:
Automate blog writing, translation, publishing and video digests
The author's Hermes Agent drafts and translates blog posts, publishes to Cloudflare Pages, makes Shorts and a weekly digest video for YouTube, and asks for approval on Telegram.
Done with
HA
Hermes Agent
What they did
Hermes Agent runs natively under systemd on an always-on Ubuntu mini-PC. For blogging, it drafts posts, translates them to German and Persian, works in a Git worktree, adds SEO metadata and opens a PR. For video, it watches the blog's RSS feed hourly, renders Shorts and a weekly digest with ffmpeg, Pillow and Google TTS, uploads them as private, and sends a Telegram Approve button.
How it went
The author says blogging drops from hours to minutes. The source gives no measured results. Scheduled publishing, thumbnails and reader-feedback analysis are still planned, and the author's later posts say he replaced Hermes with his own harness.
Worth knowing
The agent runs unsandboxed with passwordless sudo. The only protection is a Telegram allowlist and a dashboard password, so treat those as your security boundary.
Try it yourself
with
Hermes Agent
Copy prompt
Each week, draft a blog post on [topic or source material] in [language], translate it into [second language], and prepare it for publishing on [site or host]. Send me the drafts on [Telegram or other chat app] and wait for my explicit approval before publishing anything. Once I approve, publish and send me the live links.
Original source: https://ashkmb.com/blog/hermes-automation/
